That sounds like a good idea.

We don't have the budget for that.

Should we take a taxi or walk to the hotel?
It's only a few blocks away.
How often do you update the website?
The elevator is out of order again.
Have you finished editing the brochure?
When will the results of the survey be available?
By the end of next week.
Whose umbrella is this on the chair?
Doesn't the bank close at five o'clock?
No, it stays open until six on Fridays.
Yes, I'd like to open an account.
Would you rather pay by card or in cash?
The cash machine is out of order.
What should I bring to the training session tomorrow?
Just your laptop and a notebook.
Hi, Maria. Did you get a chance to look at the catering quote for the product launch?
I did. It's higher than we planned, though. They charge extra for evening service.
Hmm. What if we move the launch to the afternoon?
That could work. I'll call the caterer and ask for a new quote.
Great. I'll check with the venue to make sure the room is free before four.
Good morning. I'm calling about the apartment on Willow Street that you advertised.
Yes, it's still available. It has two bedrooms and a small balcony.
Is it close to public transportation? I don't own a car.
There's a subway station two minutes away on foot.
That's perfect. Could I see it this Saturday?
Certainly. I can show it at ten or at two. Which do you prefer?
Daniel, the monthly sales figures are in. We're up twelve percent compared with last year.
That's excellent news. Was it the new advertising campaign?
Partly. The online store also had a record number of orders in March.
We should thank the web team. Can you put together a short report?
Of course. I'll send it to you before the board meeting on Thursday.
Excuse me, I booked a table for six at seven o'clock under the name Brown.
Let me check. Ah yes, but I'm afraid the table won't be ready for another fifteen minutes.
That's fine. Is there somewhere we can wait?
You're welcome to sit in our lounge. I can bring you some drinks while you wait.
Thank you. Two of our guests are vegetarian. Is that going to be a problem?
Not at all. We have a full vegetarian menu.
Ms. Clarke, I've reviewed the proposal for the new filing system. I have a few concerns.
Of course. Which parts are you worried about?
Mainly the training schedule. Our staff are very busy at the end of the quarter.
We could offer shorter sessions, maybe forty-five minutes each, spread over two weeks.
That would be much easier. Could you also provide a user guide?
Certainly. I'll attach a draft to the revised proposal.
Tom, did you hear that the Hartley account is moving its business to another firm?
No, I didn't. That's our biggest client. Do we know why?
They said our response times were too slow last quarter.
I see. Maybe we should set up a dedicated support team for them.
I like that. Let's meet with the director this afternoon and present the idea.
Good. I'll prepare a few slides before then.
Hello, I'd like to return this jacket. I bought it last week, but it's too small.
I'm sorry about that. Do you have the receipt?
Thank you. I can either refund your money or give you a store credit. Or I can order a larger size if you'd like.
A larger size would be great. How long would that take?
It should arrive in about three days. We'll call you as soon as it's in.
Welcome to the team, Kevin. Let me show you around. This is the design studio.
Thanks. It's much bigger than I expected.
We recently expanded. Your desk is by the window, next to Ahmed's.
Great. Where do I get my security badge?
Human Resources, on the second floor. They'll also give you your laptop.
Okay. I'll go there right after the tour.
The shuttle to the conference center leaves at eight tomorrow, right?
It was supposed to, but the hotel just informed us that it's been moved to eight thirty.
That's better. It gives us time for a proper breakfast.
Agreed. By the way, did you register for the afternoon workshop?
Not yet. Is there still space?
Only a few seats. You can sign up at the front desk of the hotel.
Thanks for joining the call, everyone. We need to decide on a supplier for the new packaging.
I've compared three offers. The cheapest one is from Norvik, but their delivery usually takes a month.
That's too slow. Our launch is in six weeks, and we need time for printing.
What about Delmar Packaging? They're a little more expensive.
Yes, but they promise delivery in ten days, and they use recycled materials.
I'd go with Delmar. Customers like environmentally friendly products.
Agreed. I'll let them know today.
Hello, IT help desk. How can I help you?
Hi, I can't log in to the company network. It keeps saying my password has expired.
Passwords expire every ninety days. Let me send a reset link to your e-mail.
I don't have access to my e-mail either. It's on the same system.
I see. In that case, I'll reset it manually. Please hold for a moment.
Thank you so much. I have a presentation in twenty minutes.
Ms. Park, our records show that the maintenance contract for the copy machines ends next month.
Yes. I've been meaning to renew it, but I wanted to compare prices first.
We can offer a ten percent discount if you renew for two years instead of one.
That's tempting. Does it include replacement parts?
Yes, parts and labor are both covered.
Then please send me the new agreement, and I'll review it with my manager.
Have you seen the schedule for the museum tour? It's been changed again.
Not yet. What's the new plan?
We'll meet in the lobby at nine instead of ten, and the guide will take us through the new exhibition first.
That works for me. Should we bring anything?
Comfortable shoes, mostly. It's a long walk, and photography isn't allowed inside.
Good to know. I'll leave my camera at the hotel.

Attention, passengers on flight 218 to Toronto. Due to a technical check, boarding will be delayed by about forty minutes. The new boarding time is ten fifteen at gate twelve. Passengers who wish to have a snack may collect a free voucher at the information desk. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

Hello, Mr. Reyes, this is Helen Short from Brightway Dental. I'm calling to confirm your appointment this Thursday at three thirty. Please arrive ten minutes early to complete a short form. If you need to reschedule, call us at five five five, zero one four two before Wednesday noon. Otherwise, we look forward to seeing you.

Welcome to the Harbor Maritime Museum. Before we begin the tour, I'd like to remind you that the lower gallery is closed for renovation until June. We'll start on the second floor, where you can see models of historic ships. Please stay with the group and do not touch the displays. The tour lasts about an hour, and afterwards you're welcome to visit the gift shop.

Are you tired of slow Internet? Switch to FiberNet this month and enjoy speeds up to five times faster than ordinary connections. New customers receive free installation and their first three months at half price. This offer ends on the thirty-first, so visit fibernet dot com today, or stop by any of our stores downtown.

In local news, the city council announced today that the Riverside Bridge will close for repairs beginning next Monday. The work is expected to take three months. During this time, drivers are encouraged to use the Eastgate route, and additional buses will run between the north and south districts. A public meeting will be held on Friday evening at the town hall to answer residents' questions.

Thanks for coming, everyone. Before we start, I have two quick updates. First, the sales team has moved to the fourth floor, so please note the new extension numbers on the sheet I'm passing around. Second, our annual training day will be held on the twelfth of April. Each department should choose one person to coordinate the activities. Please send me the names by the end of the week.

This is a reminder to all employees that the cafeteria will be closed on Monday and Tuesday while the kitchen equipment is being replaced. Free coffee and sandwiches will be available in the main lobby from eleven thirty to one thirty. Employees who prefer to eat out can pick up a discount coupon for the Sunrise Cafe next door from the reception desk.

Good evening, and thank you all for attending tonight's award ceremony. This year's Employee of the Year has been with our company for fifteen years. She started in the shipping department and now leads our customer service team. Under her guidance, customer satisfaction has risen by thirty percent. Please join me in congratulating Ms. Laura Chen.

Thank you for calling Eastside Fitness. Our regular hours are six a.m. to ten p.m. on weekdays and eight a.m. to six p.m. on weekends. To hear about membership options, press one. To book a session with a personal trainer, press two. For all other questions, please stay on the line, and a member of our staff will be with you shortly.

Today I'd like to talk about how small businesses can improve their online presence. First, make sure your Web site works well on mobile phones, because more than half of customers search on them. Second, respond to online reviews quickly, whether they are positive or negative. Finally, update your content at least once a month. In the next few minutes, I will show you some simple tools that make this easier.

NOTICE: Library Hours

Beginning June 1, the Marlow Public Library will extend its weekday hours. The library will now open at 8:00 A.M. and close at 9:00 P.M., Monday through Friday. Saturday hours will remain 10:00 A.M. to 4:00 P.M. The library will stay closed on Sundays. Study rooms may be reserved at the front desk up to one week in advance. Library cards are free for all residents.

Tech Firm to Open Regional Office

BrightPath Software announced yesterday that it will open a regional office in Lakeside in September. The new office will employ about eighty people, mainly in customer support and software testing. "Lakeside has a strong pool of skilled workers," said CEO Janet Wu. The company will also partner with Lakeside College to offer internships to students. Mayor Hall welcomed the news, saying it will bring new jobs to the area. Applications for the first positions will open next month on the company's Web site.

Harbor Tours — Frequently Asked Questions

How long does the harbor cruise last?
The cruise lasts ninety minutes, including a short stop at Lighthouse Island.

Can I change my reservation?
Yes. Changes are free up to forty-eight hours before departure. After that, a ten-dollar fee applies.

Are meals included?
No, but snacks and drinks are sold on board. Passengers may also bring their own sandwiches.

Is the boat suitable for young children?
Children under twelve must be accompanied by an adult. Life jackets are provided for all passengers.

What happens if the weather is bad?
In case of storms, the cruise will be canceled and passengers will receive a full refund.

MEMO
To: All Department Heads
From: Carla Ruiz, Operations Director
Date: February 18
Re: New expense approval process

Effective March 1, all expenses over $500 must be approved by the finance office before purchase. Requests should be submitted through the new online form, which replaces the paper form used until now. Approvals will normally be given within two business days. Emergency purchases may still be made directly, but a report must be filed within one week. A training session on the online form will be held on February 26 at 2:00 P.M. in the main conference room. Attendance is recommended but not mandatory.

City Introduces Bike-Sharing Program

Starting next week, residents of Dunmore will be able to rent bicycles from twenty stations located around the city. Users can unlock a bike with a mobile app and return it to any station. The first thirty minutes of each ride are free, and additional time costs one dollar per half hour. The program, funded partly by a grant from the state, aims to reduce traffic and improve air quality. City officials say that if the program is successful, thirty more stations will be added next year.

Greenfield Farmers' Market Moves Indoors for Winter

The Greenfield Farmers' Market, a Saturday tradition for the past twelve years, will move into the Old Mill building from November 1 to March 31. The indoor location, with heating and covered parking, will host about forty vendors. Market manager Hugo Bell said the move was made possible by a donation from a local bank. "We want residents to have fresh produce all year," he said. Vendors interested in a winter stall can apply until October 15.
